text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Gold Ship
to the nurse's office, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Everything hurts like crazy all over!
I can't believe it! What a shock!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... this way.
Ah, wait, no, it's the opposite waaaay~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I can't take it anymore! This pain is unbearable!
Ripping off a scab would hurt way less than this!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'm right here with you.
It's okay, I'm here with you.
Let's blow the pain away with sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I can't take it anymore! This pain is unbearable!
Ripping off a scab would hurt way less than this!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'm right here with you.
It's okay, I'm here with you.
Let's blow the pain away with sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ugh... In that case, could you go buy me some ice cream or something?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Is that really true...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then, since you'll get bored while resting,
you'll need manga and games too... And then—
choice_data_list: Make sure you get plenty of rest.
Make sure to get a good rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, as long as I don't get bored!
Once I get bored, I end up doin' crazy stuff right away!

Afterward, Gold Ship made a full recovery
thanks to the rest... but the Trainer's
wallet suffered a critical injury.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Blow away the pain... have you?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Sounds like fun! All right, leave it to me!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Take aim... and, heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah!
Pain, pain, go away!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, owwwww?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! It bounced off the wall and came right back!
It's over, it's all oveeeeer!!

Afterward, after acting rowdy for quite a while,
Gold Ship completely ran out of steam...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, the pain's gone, but
injuries don't just heal overnight, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped! In the meantime, I'll brainstorm a countermeasure
for the sake of Golshi fans across the entire universe!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! If I don't explain our counter-strategy,
fans across the entire universe won't be able to sleep at night!
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we rethink our training?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Our new catchphrase is...
"Ultra Peace of Mind! Absolute Safe Training!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Something feels kinda fishy about that.
Hmm, isn't there anything else...?

Afterward, through much trial and error,
the two of them came up with a new menu.
